import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import execution_spec as E
from execute_provider import provider_contract
from observe_output import no_turn, observe
assert E.CURRENT_PROVIDER_CONTRACT >= 8 and 8 in E.PROVIDER_CONTRACTS_V3

obs = observe("agy", raw)
assert obs["observed_model"] == {"value": "gemini-3.8-flash-low", "source": "observed"}, obs

hang = json.loads(lines[4]); hang["result"].update(response="", num_turns=0)

print("ok")

import json, os, pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")

drift_rows = [json.loads(line) for f in (pathlib.Path("docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/drift.jsonl"), pathlib.Path(live, ".tasks/drift/20261014-2a-foundation.jsonl")) if f.is_file() for line in f.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
drift_to = {(r["seat"], r["to"]["provider"], r["to"]["model"]) for r in drift_rows}
assert ("agy.economy", "agy", "gemini-3.8-flash-medium") in drift_to, drift_to
assert ("agy.premium", "agy", "gemini-4-argon-high") in drift_to, drift_to
assert ("brain", "agy", "claude-opus-5-5-high") in drift_to, drift_to
v_t026 = json.loads(pathlib.Path("docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/verification/95b74d55-a25b-4e52-93d3-9d853c83d95e.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
